rows.firstMinute: Open the menu and enable the local mashup encounter.
rows.behavior: Opt-in menu with board, portal tool, encounter start/stop and editable bindings.
rows.acceptance: Opening and closing the menu preserves ordinary campaign input; holding the chord does not repeatedly toggle it.

rows.firstMinute: Enable board mode and perform one ollie or flip from installed skate. data.
rows.behavior: One board, controller flick gesture and keyboard equivalent, installed trick names/parameters and event audio.
rows.acceptance: The displayed and scored trick resolves to the player-owned skate. records; disabling restores normal on-foot movement.

rows.firstMinute: Place linked portals and cross once while preserving momentum.
rows.behavior: A blue/orange pair moves player, current vehicle and nearby eligible NPCs/infected; rotate position, velocity and heading.
rows.acceptance: Two-way traversal works once per crossing, preserves speed, rejects obstructed exits and restores ordinary collision.

rows.firstMinute: Start one small local wave and lure its Tank through a portal.
rows.behavior: Local encounter using real installed Left 4 Dead 2 infected content; no global campaign replacement.
rows.acceptance: Only encounter-owned entities are removed on stop; real L4D2 content is visibly present and the Tank can be trapped through portals.
